I am a data scientist in the making, currently in UBC's Master of Data Science program. My path here ran through a Master's in Economics, where a causal-impact study on COVID-19's effect on Bangladesh's macroeconomy first pulled me toward the field. Before circling back to it, I spent seven years as a creative director in Bangladeshi advertising, learning how to turn complexity into things people actually understand. That combination is what I bring: quantitative rigour with the communication craft to match. Long-term, I am drawn to high-stakes, data-rich domains like energy markets, healthcare analytics, and derivatives, where good models change real decisions and clear explanations of them are rare.
